events.title: Cold Rain
events.text: A steady cold rain soaks the woodpile and sends everyone indoors early.

options.label: Cover the stores
options.result_text: The food stays dry, but good kindling is spent on the covers.

options.label: Keep gathering
options.result_text: The village pushes through the rain and comes back worn down.

events.title: Heat Haze
events.text: The afternoon shimmers with heat, and tempers shorten around the campfire.

options.label: Shorten the day
options.result_text: Rest cools everyone down, but less work gets done.

options.label: Work through it
options.result_text: The work gets done, but one villager wilts by dusk.

events.title: Early Frost
events.text: A pale frost settles before dawn and bites at the last soft growth.

options.label: Harvest quickly
options.result_text: The village saves some food before the frost deepens.

options.label: Protect seedlings
options.result_text: The careful work preserves future forage, but costs warm cover.

events.title: Clear Skies
events.text: A bright, windless day makes the forest paths easy to read.

options.label: Send gatherers
options.result_text: The gatherers return with dry baskets and good spirits.

options.label: Repair roofs
options.result_text: The dry weather is spent on patching and tying down shelters.

events.title: High Winds
events.text: Hard gusts snap branches and carry strange sounds through the trees.

options.label: Gather fallen limbs
options.result_text: The wind leaves a useful scatter of dry wood.

options.label: Stay near camp
options.result_text: Everyone keeps close watch until the wind dies.

events.title: Wolf Tracks
events.text: Fresh tracks circle the far side of the camp before turning back into the pines.

options.label: Double the watch
options.result_text: The tracks are studied and the camp sleeps more easily.

options.label: Follow them
options.result_text: The hunters learn the pack's route but come back shaken.

events.title: Deer Near Camp
events.text: A small deer herd grazes close enough that even the children spot them.

options.label: Careful hunt
options.result_text: The hunters take only what they can carry safely.

options.label: Let them pass
options.result_text: The quiet mercy lifts the camp's mood.

events.title: Boar in the Brush
events.text: A rooting boar blocks a berry trail and refuses to move.

options.label: Drive it off
options.result_text: The trail is cleared, but one villager takes a hard fall.

options.label: Avoid the trail
options.result_text: The village leaves the boar alone and loses a day of easy forage.

events.title: Owls Alarm
events.text: Owls cry all night from the same ridge, and the guards swear something moved there.

options.label: Scout the ridge
options.result_text: The scout finds no beast, only a better watch point.

options.label: Ignore the omen
options.result_text: Sleep returns, though the ridge stays in everyone's thoughts.

events.title: Scavenger Raid
events.text: Small night scavengers scatter the edge stores before anyone can shout.

options.label: Save the food
options.result_text: Most of the stores are recovered after a frantic chase.

options.label: Secure the camp
options.result_text: The animals get more food, but the gaps in camp are fixed.

events.title: Coughing Night
events.text: A dry cough passes between bedrolls before sunrise.

options.label: Isolate early
options.result_text: The cough is contained, but the sick villager cannot work well.

options.label: Share warm broth
options.result_text: The broth comforts everyone and uses a little food.

events.title: Fever Child
events.text: A young villager burns with fever while the herbalist searches the shelves.

options.label: Use rare herbs
options.result_text: The fever breaks and the camp breathes again.

options.label: Wait and watch
options.result_text: The fever lingers and leaves the camp uneasy.

events.title: Spoiled Water
events.text: The morning water smells wrong, sour with leaves and mud.

options.label: Boil every pot
options.result_text: The water is safe, though the fire eats through extra wood.

options.label: Risk the stream
options.result_text: Work starts quickly, but one villager turns pale by noon.

events.title: Herb Mold
events.text: A bundle of stored herbs has gone soft with pale mold.

options.label: Throw it out
options.result_text: The bad bundle is burned before it spreads.

options.label: Sort what remains
options.result_text: Careful hands save enough clean herbs for later.

events.title: Tired Bones
events.text: Several villagers wake stiff and slow after a hard week.

options.label: Call a rest hour
options.result_text: The rest steadies the camp and costs a little output.

options.label: Push onward
options.result_text: The work continues, and the strain shows.

events.title: Hidden Roots
events.text: A child finds a patch of edible roots beneath a fallen log.

options.label: Dig carefully
options.result_text: The roots come up clean and filling.

options.label: Mark the patch
options.result_text: The village takes less now and keeps the spot easy to find.

events.title: Cracked Grain Bin
events.text: A corner of the grain bin splits open, spilling food into the dirt.

options.label: Patch it now
options.result_text: The bin is saved with rough planks.

options.label: Scoop what fell
options.result_text: More food is recovered, but the bin stays fragile.

events.title: Trader Leftovers
events.text: A passing trader leaves a small sack behind the old stump.

options.label: Take the sack
options.result_text: The sack holds dry beans and a little twine.

options.label: Leave a token
options.result_text: The village keeps its manners and its hopes for trade.

events.title: Mushroom Patch
events.text: Bright mushrooms push up near the damp stones after rain.

options.label: Ask the herbalist
options.result_text: Only the safe caps are kept.

options.label: Gather quickly
options.result_text: The baskets fill fast, but one villager regrets tasting early.

events.title: Ration Argument
events.text: Two families argue over whether the evening portions are fair.

options.label: Share evenly
options.result_text: The argument cools, though the stores drop faster.

options.label: Hold rations
options.result_text: The stores last, but the decision stings.

events.title: Watch Blame
events.text: A missing bundle of kindling turns into accusations about last night's watch.

options.label: Hear both sides
options.result_text: The truth is dull, but the hearing restores trust.

options.label: Assign extra watch
options.result_text: The camp feels safer, and the accused guard sleeps poorly.

events.title: Tool Argument
events.text: The woodcutter and hunter both claim the sharpest axe for the morning.

options.label: Give it to woodcutting
options.result_text: Wood comes in faster, while the hunter grumbles.

options.label: Give it to hunting
options.result_text: The hunter brings back meat and promises to share the axe tomorrow.

events.title: Shelter Quarrel
events.text: A leaking roof starts a bitter argument about who sleeps by the wall.

options.label: Patch the leak
options.result_text: The quarrel ends under a rough new patch.

options.label: Rotate sleeping spots
options.result_text: The rule is fair enough, but nobody sleeps perfectly.

events.title: Missing Charm
events.text: A carved charm vanishes from a doorway, and suspicion spreads quickly.

options.label: Search together
options.result_text: The charm is found in a blanket fold, and everyone laughs with relief.

options.label: Forbid accusations
options.result_text: The camp quiets, but the charm stays missing.

events.title: Forager Boast
events.text: A forager boasts too loudly about carrying the village, and others bristle.

options.label: Praise everyone
options.result_text: The elder names each job around the fire, softening the boast.

options.label: Test the boast
options.result_text: The forager proves useful and comes back exhausted.
